threshold_convention: x2_bg.margins_of: significant iff max|That| > max(1e-9, 1e-3*|rho_peak|); per-region margins reported both over significant points (sig) and over all points (raw, strict); regions: cavity r<9, taper 9<=r<10 and 20<r<=21, core 10<=r<=20, shellband 9<=r<=21, exterior r>21
coordinate_limit: static areal coordinates singular at r=2M_bg; audit radii >= 2M_bg+1.5, stencil reach 4h<=1.2
support: prescription windowed (C^infty bump) to [9,21], =1 on [10,20]; BCs p_r=p_bg at both window edges (p_bg=0 for Schwarzschild)
verdict_rule: schw: TOTAL tensor judges (background is vacuum); ads: DIFFERENCE tensor judges the shell (the background own WEC failure, rho_bg<0, is background). PASS requires: core [10,20] raw judge margins > 0 at h=0.3,0.2,0.1 with Type I fraction > 0.99; cavity/taper/exterior positive or FD-floor (deficit shrinks >=3x from h=0.2 to 0.1 and |worst(0.1)| <= 5e-7); for beta=0 the exact 1D spherical margins must confirm (core > 0, band > -1e-9). A constant-in-h deficit is physics.
